name: Between Us
notes: 4 photos: 1 & 2 are duplicate happy-hour drink/bites boards (Bite, Draft Beer, Wine), 3 is a happy-hour promo flyer with food photography and no itemized list, 4 is the full soft-opening dinner menu. Dishes merged across the happy-hour Bite section and the dinner menu where they were the same item under different names/prices (Foccacia/House Focaccia, Fried Calamari/Squid Tentacles, Chips & Dip, Snack Wings, Steamed Mussels) keeping the dinner-menu version; French Fries only appeared on the happy-hour board. Draft Beer and Wine sections skipped as drink-only.
